episode_title: The Mortgage AI Search Index: Who Google, ChatGPT and Gemini Really Quote
question: What percentage of Google AI overview results for mortgage searches cite at least one broker website?
transcript_excerpt: 83% of the time at least one broker website is being cited in the AI overview at the top. This was tested across over 7,500 searches, with 5,039 different websites quoted across 12,185 answers, showing significant opportunity for brokers of all sizes to be featured.

episode_title: The Mortgage AI Search Index: Who Google, ChatGPT and Gemini Really Quote
question: How often do Google AI overviews include YouTube videos when searching mortgage-related questions?
transcript_excerpt: Nearly half the time, 47% of searches, a Google AI overview includes a YouTube video as a reference link when you search mortgage-related questions. This increased from 34% the previous week, showing an upward trend in video inclusion.

episode_title: The Mortgage AI Search Index: Who Google, ChatGPT and Gemini Really Quote
question: What is the citation percentage difference between Google AI overview and ChatGPT when recommending brokers for mortgage scenarios?
transcript_excerpt: When searches ask for broker recommendations to help with mortgage scenarios, Google AI overview quotes brokers 83% of the time compared to ChatGPT at 82% this week. However, when the question is simply a mortgage query without asking for a recommendation, ChatGPT only quoted brokers 43% of the time versus Google's 83%.

podcast_name: Advisers Assemble -  Mortgage Leads - Lead Generation For Financial Services
episode_title: The Mortgage AI Search Index: Who Google, ChatGPT and Gemini Really Quote
question: How does Reddit compare to other social platforms in Google AI overview citations for mortgage content?
transcript_excerpt: Reddit appeared in 23% of Google AI overview results for mortgage searches, up from 17% the previous week, making it the most-quoted social platform. In contrast, TikTok was cited less than 1% of the time, while Facebook was second and Instagram third among social sources.

question: What percentage of mortgage-related AI searches cite official UK financial sites like FCA or Money Helper?
transcript_excerpt: Google AI overview quoted official sites such as Money Helper, FCA, or gov.uk only 23% of the time. ChatGPT quoted official sites at 35%, while Gemini cited them just 15% of the time, despite expectations that official sources would feature more prominently.
